name: von-system-one
description: Von System One decision model. A fast local model that answers typed questions about text in one pass: pick a choice, give a score, or say yes or no, each with a calibrated probability. It serves the Jev-compatible /v1/systemone HTTP API for routing, triage, moderation and guardrails. Before first start: 1. Pick cpu or nvidia when you install. The nvidia choice sets Extra Parameters to --runtime=nvidia for you and needs the Unraid NVIDIA Driver plugin. 2. Optional: set an API key. Clients then send Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY. Leave it blank for no key. 3. The first start downloads the model weights (about 3 GB) into the Model cache folder. The cpu tag also saves an OpenVINO copy there (about 3 GB more). The container shows healthy when the model is loaded. The API docs page is at http://YOUR_Unraid_IP:8013/docs. Keep the port on a trusted network.

paths.name: Model cache
paths.description: Downloaded model weights. The container sets the owner to PUID:PGID at start.

ports.name: API port
ports.description: Host port for the /v1/systemone API, /health and the /docs page.

variables.name: API key
variables.description: Optional. Blank means no key is needed. When set, clients send Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY. /health never needs a key.

variables.name: Load model at start
variables.description: 1 loads the model before the server listens, so the first request is fast. With 1, the nvidia tag loads on the CPU when the GPU is full. 0 loads it on the first request.

variables.name: CPU threads
variables.description: Threads for CPU work. Keep at or below your physical core count.

variables.name: Allowed web origins
variables.description: Web pages allowed to call the API from a browser. * allows all. For a list, separate origins with commas, for example http://192.168.1.10:3000.

variables.name: Hugging Face token
variables.description: Optional. The model is public and needs no token.

variables.name: Offline mode
variables.description: 1 uses only the model already in the Model cache and never downloads.

variables.name: Log level
variables.description: One of critical, error, warning, info, debug or trace.

variables.name: NVIDIA GPU
variables.description: nvidia tag only. Use all or one GPU UUID from the NVIDIA Driver plugin page.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User the server runs as. Unraid default is 99 (nobody).

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group the server runs as. Unraid default is 100 (users).
